events.title_original: Why the genocide verdict against Myanmar has big implications for Israel | Geoffrey Robertson
events.summary: Proving the ‘crime of crimes’ against an individual is notoriously difficult, but the ICJ has set a precedent for states to be found liable. Israel could be next  For the first time ever, a state has been found  guilty of genocide  – that “crime of crimes” – and has been ordered to compensate victims and to prosecute and punish the perpetrators. This judgment came from the international court of justice (ICJ), which has convicted Myanmar of killing and expelling many thousands of Rohingyas  in Rakhine state in 2017 .  （原文待翻译）
